updates.title: Software Update
updates.body: Clearer download progress, with downloads continuing when you leave the page.

updates.title: Home
updates.body: Smoother entry, refreshed camera controls and stable bottom tabs.

updates.title: Briefing
updates.body: See cancellations, diversions, long delays and today’s reminders.

updates.title: Play
updates.body: Clearer glass controls, next/previous for live cameras and slimmer bars. Fixed the clipped PiP button in landscape.

updates.title: Liquid Glass
updates.body: Fixed the text at the bottom.

updates.title: Two players
updates.body: Choose between Android and Native players.

previous.title: A better Play, fresher Briefing and easier updates

updates.title: Play controls
updates.body: A roomier player and compact controls leave more space for your video library. Choose preferred quality, color and subtitles from the library bar.

updates.title: Playback fixes
updates.body: The time label now follows the seek handle. Menus line up with the control bar, with smaller quality and color menus and better placement in landscape.

updates.title: Live webcams
updates.body: Tap LIVE to open the timeline on supported streams, move back and return to live. Clearer playback messages offer a retry when a video is interrupted.

updates.title: Jackson Hole Stories
updates.body: Discover five short films about Town Square, the antler arches, the Crabtree Hotel and more of Jackson Hole's history.

updates.title: Briefing
updates.body: A refreshed layout brings weather, flight updates and helpful summaries together. Tap a flight update to find matching flights.

updates.title: Briefing updates
updates.body: See when information was updated, refresh it easily and get clearer loading and offline messages. Old flight information is kept out of today's summary.

updates.title: App Icons
updates.body: Browse 29 icons in Standard, Glass, Winter and JH collections with larger previews. Quick selections keep your last choice, and Settings shows your current icon.

updates.title: Background update downloads
updates.body: Update downloads continue when you leave the app. Return to Software Update to see progress or install when ready, with a Retry option if a download fails.
